evidence: All five prompts (task/tests/gates/{render,constraints}/prompt.md, task/tests/scored/{functional,polish,visual}/prompt.md) open http://localhost:3000, inject {app_context} (substituted by tests/test.sh:198-200) and describe only HireOps. A proper-name sweep over every prompt, judge.toml and app_context.md returns only HireOps entities (Rafael Costa, Mei Lin, Farah Nasser, Ingrid Sorensen, Bill Okafor, Yuki Tanaka, Aud Halvorsen, Noor Haddad, Tomas Varga, Lena Fischer, Platform Engineer, Data Analyst, Product Designer, Greta Lindqvist, Ade Bello, Marco Rossi, Priya Nair, Samuel Ortiz); a residue grep (colderwater|tenant|ticket|invoice|receipt|patient|warehouse|ledger|booking|kanban|example.com|admin@|TODO|lorem) finds nothing beyond the literal prompt_template key. Credentials: app_context.md:8-19 password Hireops!2026 and ten accounts/roles exactly match instruction.md:17, hireops_rules.md:11 and seed users (USR-REC1..3 recruiter, USR-MGR1..3 hiring_manager, USR-OBS1 observer, USR-CAN1..3 candidate). Screens: app_context.md:23-25 stages Applied..Rejected match seed 'stages' and rules §3; Board/Conversations/Activity + candidate applications view match instruction.md:11. Seed facts quoted in prompts re-derived from seed_data.json: three jobs (JOB-PLAT/DATA/DSGN); Platform Engineer Applied Greta Lindqvist, Ade Bello, Marco Rossi and Screen Priya Nair, Samuel Ortiz by position (functional prompt.md:25, hro_restart); Noor's note 'Strong systems answers; weaker on incident follow-up.' (APP-101 note); Noor's Platform Engineer conversation 120 messages (APP-101 count 120; app_context.md:29-30); Lena's Product Designer unread 1 (APP-301 has 3 messages, Lena read_count 2, third sent by USR-REC3) (prompt Z, hro_unread_counts); Tomas's seeded Data Analyst conversation exists (APP-201); page size 30 (thread_page_size, hro_thread_latest/earlier); candidate wording in hro_candidate_view equals seed candidate_status_labels. Role/rule statements checked against hireops_rules.md: interview places 1-50 whole (S refusals 0/51/2.5), manager limited to Interview/Offer/Hired on own job (R, hro_mgr_*), manager reopen only of Interview/Offer rejections, observer read-only, manager of another job refused from conversations (Ingrid on J2), candidate 404 for others' applications (Noor 'not found'), seen semantics (observer never counts; Bill as J2 manager counts), unread semantics for Mei, undo rules (note does not count, reorder/reject by others block, single undo, later move supersedes), bulk board-order arrival (Y,W,X; A2,V), 409 with who for stale moves, activity excluding notes. Walked protocols S/M/L/B stage-by-stage: every expected outcome is consistent with the rules (e.g. L: A,B fill 2 places; undo of E refused while full, allowed after Mei frees a place; B(13) A2 Applied->Screen and V Interview->Screen are one-step and arrive A2,V). Cross-prompt consistency: polish prompt.md:16 forbids Lena's conversation, protecting functional Z's unread baseline; visual is read-only; gates do not open conversations; restart tool name restart_app matches tools/restart_mcp.py:14. The deliverable described (live desk, board, conversations, candidates) matches task.toml description and instruction.md. Minor non-defect observation: the scored in-dimension gate text (functional/polish/visual prompt.md:11) asks for 'any hiring manager and 2 interview places' without naming team/source, while hro_gate_shared and rules §2 include team and source; this is an omission of optional detail (a judge fills required fields through the UI), not a misdescription or residue, and no conforming app fails because of it. Adversarial attempts: (a) broken app passing because a prompt describes a different product or wrong accounts - none found, all accounts/entities exist in seed; (b) conforming app failing because a prompt states a wrong seed fact (order, note, unread baseline, message count, role) - every quoted seed fact re-derived correctly. This row is a source-level consistency check; no runtime measurement is required for it and none is claimed (no Oracle, model or portal score asserted).
